අƯ ɪෙශෂThe Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka

IT is hereby notified that the President of Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka beging the Commander in chief of the Armed Forces, has been graciously pleased to confer the Videsha Seva Padakkama as per regulation four of the Presidential warrant in instituting, constituting and creating the Videsha Seva Padakkama , published in the Government Gazette Extraordinary No. 156/5 of 1st September 1981, on the persons named in the Schedule hereto.
By Order of His Excellency’s the President,

Air Vice Marshal SAMPATH THUYACONTHA (Retd) WWV, RWP and two Bars, RSP and Bar, USP,MMSc (Strat Stu.China), MSc(Def Stu) in Mgt, MSc(Def Strat Stu), fndu (China),psc Secretary, Ministry of Defence. At Colombo.08th December, 2025.
This Gazette Extraordinary can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk
